generatedProse.practice-connection: In the School of Sport, these genres are the working documents of sport and exercise study. A literature review opens your dissertation and every journal article you read; a proposal must satisfy a supervisor and an ethics panel before data are collected; a report in introduction, method, results and discussion form is how findings are communicated. Whether you work in the lab, on the training ground or in the clinic, treat what follows as being about your own reviews, proposals and reports, not about research in the abstract.
